header.about: Whole characters from the balance tool (tools/balance): one race, class and level in the tool's melee kit with its standing buffs against the band's reference monster. A `cell` case has `inputs` (class, race, level, trained stats in the order Str Int Wil Agl Hea Cha, the wielded weapon and worn item numbers, the buff spell numbers, the target monster number) and `tool`: the best move's damage a round at the steady state (`dpr`, with `weave_dpr` the part the weave dealt and `weapon_dpr` the part the weapon's spells dealt), blows a round, hit chance in percent, the energy a blow costs, the attack value, and the tool's hit points, mana, stealth and bonuses for the cross-checks. The `tables` case holds the rows those numbers name. Item row: number, weight, type, ac, dr, weapon type, armour type, worn, accuracy, strength required, speed, min, max, classes, races, negated spells, abilities as [ability, value]. Spell row: number, level, energy, mana, min, max, diff, resist mode, target, duration, element, magery, magery level, cap, max levels, max increment, min levels, min increment, duration levels, duration increment, abilities, whether a class can learn it. Class row: number, base hp, hp per level, exp, magery, magery level, weapon class, armour type, combat, abilities. Race row: number, minimum stats, maximum stats (Str Int Wil Agl Hea Cha), hp bonus, exp, abilities. Monster row: number, ac, dr, magic resistance, backstab defence, hp, energy, undead, alignment, abilities.
